messages:
sam: Hey all — addressed the comments from earlier (moved the helper into runtime/kv_utils, added a unit test for the eviction edge case, and squashed the fixup commits). PTAL when you have a sec.

tanya: thank you! will skim in the next hour. quick q: did you keep the old metrics tag for the eviction path or rename it?

sam: renamed to kv.eviction_v2_metrics (keeps the semantic but avoids collision). updated dashboards reference in the PR description.

igor: running the canary locally now; small note — one integration test flakes intermittently on aarch64, could be unrelated but FYI.

sam: noted — I added a short retry in the test harness and left a TODO to follow up with the CI infra team. patch is in this commit: `git show --name-only HEAD` (link in PR).

ci-bot: CI started for branch `fix/kv-evict` — full matrix. Results will post here when complete. :gear:

tanya: quick pass done. code looks good; unit test is clear and the helper extraction makes the runtime file nicer. left one tiny nit inline about a comment typo.

sam: fixed the typo and pushed. thanks!

igor: canary run finished: metrics look stable, latency within baseline, integration suite passed aside from the aarch64 flake which retried ok. recommend canary -> promote if release-coordinator is good with timing.

release-coordinator: schedule-wise we have a canary window at 16:00 UTC today. if this is merged before then we can include it in the 16:30 promote. otherwise it'll be the next window tomorrow morning. @sam can you squash the last two commits into one and I'll merge post-green canary?

sam: will squash and force-push in 5m. will ping here once done. thanks!

ci-bot: CI passed for `fix/kv-evict` (all checks green) — https://ci.internal/12345 :white_check_mark:

sam: done and pushed. PTAL again @tanya @igor — squash commit message: "runtime: extract kv helper and fix eviction edge case"

tanya: LGTM from me. :+1:

igor: LGTM. merging after canary window unless release-coordinator says otherwise.

release-coordinator: sounds good — will promote at 16:30 UTC if canary stays green. please hold on hotfix branches until after promote.

sam: thanks everyone. pinging here once promote completes.

ci-bot: Promote started for canary batch `2026-03-17-canary-7` — tracking: https://deploys.internal/7890

release-coordinator: promote successful, no regressions observed. merged `fix/kv-evict` into main and scheduled post-release smoke checks.

sam: excellent, thanks! :tada:

tanya: nice work!

igor: thanks. I'll follow up on the aarch64 flaky test next sprint.
